sloka: वृक्षेभ्यो अन्ये तु कपयो नर्दन्तो मधु दर्पिताः ।अन्ये वृक्षान् प्रपद्यन्ते प्रपतन्ति अपि च अपरे ॥६-४-९३॥।।
transliteration: vṛkṣebhyo anye tu kapayo nardanto madhu darpitāḥ ।anye vṛkṣān prapadyante prapatanti api ca apare ॥6-4-93॥।।

translations.english: While some monkeys that were intoxicated by drinking excessive honey walked where there were no trees, others climbed the tree tops and jumped.
